deadline.value: Apply by February 8, 2027 (all documents including IELTS scores) to be considered for recruitment awards.
deadline.quote: Biology Canadian and International student application deadline: February 8, 2027

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Contact professors first and apply formally only after one expresses strong interest; applicants with no willing supervisor are rejected.
supervisor.quote: Do not make a formal application until at least one professor expresses strong interest in taking you on as a graduate student.

also.quote: If no faculty member is willing to supervise an applicant, or insufficient funds are available to cover the minimum guaranteed level of support, the application is rejected by the Coordinator.

funding.value: The department guarantees a minimum stipend for the first four years of full-time PhD study.
funding.quote: The Biology Department guarantees a minimum level of financial support (i.e., stipend) (i) for the first four years of full-time study in the PhD program

entry_route.value: Normally an MSc with upper second-class standing; direct entry from a BSc only in exceptional cases.
entry_route.quote: normally an upper second-class degree or better in an MSc program for acceptance to the PhD program, although direct entry from a BSc program into a PhD is possible in exceptional circumstances

notes: About 10 new PhD students a year.
